text:
maria: FYI my docs PR (#2946) is failing the CI docs build — Docusaurus throws 'Duplicate heading id' and the site build exits.

kevin: can you paste the error output?

maria: here's the relevant snippet from the Netlify log:
```
[error] Duplicate heading id "install-linux"
```
Looks like headings with inline code / parentheses are collapsing to the same slug.

alex: likely caused by headings like:

## Install (Linux)

and

## Install `Linux`

both become `install-linux`.

lisa: I saw this when links with parentheses were used too: `[guide](../setup/guide.md#install (linux))` — the space+paren wrecks the anchor.

maria: exact offending file: `docs/guides/setup.md` line 42:
`[Install instructions](../getting-started.md#install (linux))` — the parentheses aren't escaped.

kevin: Docusaurus (markdown-it) normalizes heading ids; parentheses and code spans often removed, so multiple headings reduce to the same slug. Fix options:
- change headings to have explicit IDs: `## Install (Linux) {#install-linux}`
- avoid inline code/paren combos in headings
- escape parentheses in inline links: `#install\\ (linux)`
- or adjust the link to point to a simple id.

alex: easiest: add explicit IDs for ambiguous headings. I'll open a small patch.

maria: also saw a different failure: a fenced code block with an inner triple-backtick snippet seemed to confuse the parser and truncated the generated page. Might be an unclosed fence earlier in the doc.

lisa: yup, unclosed fences + weird inline HTML can cause the markdown parser to mis-handle subsequent headings. Suggest running a local build to catch.

kevin: commands to reproduce locally:
- git checkout <branch>
- cd web
- yarn
- yarn build:docs
(If you use pnpm: `pnpm install && pnpm --filter docs build`)

alex: I'll push a PR: change ambiguous headings in `docs/guides/getting-started.md` and `docs/guides/setup.md` to explicit IDs, fix the inline link escaping in the offending line, and tidy up code fences.

maria: thx. @docs-bot can you re-run the docs build after PR lands?

docs-bot: queued rerun of docs CI for PR #2946 — will start after merge.

lisa: small follow-up — can we add a short dev docs section `docs/contrib/markdown.md` called "Avoiding anchor collisions" with recommended patterns (explicit IDs, avoid punctuation in headings, run local build)? I'll draft it.

kevin: SGTM. Alex, can you add the draft to the same PR to save cycles?

alex: yes, will include example snippets and a local-build checklist (`yarn build:docs`) in the PR.

maria: awesome. I'll watch the PR and confirm the site rebuilds cleanly after merge :thumbsup:
